items.headline: Fresno State wins Pac-12 debut, beats Washington State 26-6
items.description: — Wide receiver Josiah Freeman scored on a reverse and Fresno State beat Washington State 23-6 on Saturday night in the inaugural game for both teams in the new-look Pac-12 Conference.

items.headline: Fifita throws 4 touchdown passes in Arizona's 34-24 win over Washington State
items.description: — Noah Fifita threw for 297 yards and four touchdowns and Arizona overcame a halftime deficit for a 34-24 victory over Washington State on Saturday night.
